description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations related to the Field UI module, including functions for adding third-party settings to field formatters and widgets, and for altering their settings summaries.

methods.name: hook_field_formatter_third_party_settings_form
methods.description: Adds a custom 'my_setting' checkbox to the formatter settings form for specific formatter plugins.

methods.name: hook_field_widget_third_party_settings_form
methods.description: Adds a custom 'my_setting' checkbox to the widget settings form for specific widget plugins.

methods.name: hook_field_formatter_settings_summary_alter
methods.description: Appends a message to the formatter settings summary if 'foo_formatter' has 'my_setting' enabled.

methods.name: hook_field_widget_settings_summary_alter
methods.description: Appends a message to the widget settings summary if 'foo_widget' has 'my_setting' enabled.
